english: Do you have difficulty controlling your bowel movements?
transliteration: hal ta-JI-du Su-OO-ba-tan fee-t-ta-HUK-kum fit-tab-ar-ruz?
translation: هل تجد صعوبة في التحكم في التبرز؟

english: Do you have diarrhea?
transliteration: hal la-DAI-ka is-HAA-l?
translation: هل لديك إسهال؟

english: How many loose stools have you had today?
transliteration: kam mar-rah ta-bar-raz-ta ba-raa-zan LAI-yi-nan al-YAWM?
translation: كم مرة تبرزت برازًا لينًا اليوم؟

english: How long have you had diarrhea?
transliteration: mun-dhu ma-TAA wa-an-ta mu-SAA-bun bil-is-HAA-l?
translation: منذ متى وأنت مصاب بالإسهال؟

english: Do you have cramps before passing stool?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-ta-QAL-lu-saat qab-lat-tab-ar-ruz?
translation: هل تشعر بتقلصات قبل التبرز؟

english: Do you feel an urgent need to use the toilet?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-HAA-ja-tin mu-lih-hah i-la-dha-HAA-bi i-lal-HAM-maam?
translation: هل تشعر بحاجة ملحة إلى الذهاب إلى الحمام؟

english: Are you constipated?
transliteration: hal tu-AA-nee mi-nil-im-SAAK?
translation: هل تعاني من الإمساك؟

english: Do you strain when passing stool?
transliteration: hal taD-gha-Tu bi-QUW-wa-tin in-da-t-tab-ar-ruz?
translation: هل تضغط بقوة عند التبرز؟

english: Have you passed gas today?
transliteration: hal akh-raj-ta GAA-zaat al-YAWM?
translation: هل أخرجت غازات اليوم؟

english: Are you taking laxatives or stool softeners?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NA-wa-lu mu-lay-yi-naat aw ad-WI-ya-tan li-tal-yeenil-ba-RAAZ?
translation: هل تتناول ملينات أو أدوية لتليين البراز؟

english: Has anyone around you also had diarrhea?
transliteration: hal u-SI-ba a-ha-dun mim-man haw-la-ka bil-is-HAA-li ay-DHan?
translation: هل أصيب أحد من حولك بالإسهال أيضًا؟

english: Do you have heartburn or burning in your chest?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-ha-ra-qa-tin fil-ma-i-dah aw bi-ha-ra-qa-tin fee SAD-rik?
translation: هل تشعر بحرقة في المعدة أو بحرقة في صدرك؟

english: Do you have acid coming up into your throat?
transliteration: hal yaS-a-dul-ha-mi-Du i-la hal-Qik?
translation: هل يصعد الحمض إلى حلقك؟

english: Do you have a sour taste in your mouth?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-TAM-in HAA-mi-Din fee FAM-ik?
translation: هل تشعر بطعم حامض في فمك؟

english: Do you burp frequently?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-ja-sh-sha-u ka-THEE-ran?
translation: هل تتجشأ كثيرًا؟

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food?
transliteration: hal ta-JI-du Su-OO-ba-tan fee BAL-iT-ta-AA-m?
translation: هل تجد صعوبة في بلع الطعام؟

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-a-la-min in-dal-BAL?
translation: هل تشعر بألم عند البلع؟

english: Is it harder to swallow solids or liquids?
transliteration: hal yaS-u-bu a-LAI-ka BAL-ul-aT-i-ma-tis-SUL-bah am as-sa-waa-il?
translation: هل يصعب عليك بلع الأطعمة الصلبة أم السوائل؟

english: Does food ever feel stuck in your chest?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru aa-hi-ya-nan bi-an-nat-ta-AA-ma AA-li-q-un fee SAD-rik?
translation: هل تشعر أحيانًا بأن الطعام عالق في صدرك؟

english: Do you cough or choke when swallowing?
transliteration: hal ta-SUL-u aw takh-ta-ni-qu in-dal-BAL?
translation: هل تسعل أو تختنق عند البلع؟

english: Do you feel full after eating only a small amount?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bish-shi-ba-i ba-da ta-NA-wu-li kam-mi-ya-tin qa-LEE-la-tin fa-QAT?
translation: هل تشعر بالشبع بعد تناول كمية قليلة فقط؟

english: Does your abdomen feel bloated or swollen?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-in-ti-faa-khin aw ta-war-rum fee baT-ni-ka?
translation: هل تشعر بانتفاخ أو تورم في بطنك؟

english: Are you passing more gas than usual?
transliteration: hal takh-ru-ju min-ka GAA-zaat ak-tha-ru mi-nal-mu-taa-d?
translation: هل تخرج منك غازات أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Have you lost your appetite?
transliteration: hal fa-QAD-ta sha-hi-ya-ta-ka?
translation: هل فقدت شهيتك؟

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: hal fa-QAD-ta waz-nan min DOO-ni an tu-HAA-wil?
translation: هل فقدت وزنًا من دون أن تحاول؟

english: Have you gained weight unexpectedly?
transliteration: hal ZAA-da waz-nu-ka a-la nah-win ghairi mu-ta-WAQ-qa?
translation: هل زاد وزنك على نحو غير متوقع؟

english: Have you changed your diet recently?
transliteration: hal gha-yaR-ta ni-ZAA-ma-ka-lghi-DHAA-ee mu-AKH-kha-ran?
translation: هل غيرت نظامك الغذائي مؤخرًا؟

english: Do you avoid any foods because of symptoms?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-JAN-na-bu aT-i-ma-tan mu-ay-ya-na-tan bi-sa-ba-bil-a-RAAD?
translation: هل تتجنب أطعمة معينة بسبب الأعراض؟

english: How much water do you drink each day?
transliteration: kam-mi-ya-tul-MAA-il-la-tee tash-ra-bu-haa yaw-mi-yan?
translation: كمية الماء التي تشربها يوميًا؟

english: When did you last eat or drink?
transliteration: ma-TAA ka-na a-khi-ru mar-ra-tin a-kal-ta aw sha-rib-ta fee-haa?
translation: متى كانت آخر مرة أكلت أو شربت فيها؟

english: Have you ever had liver disease or hepatitis?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an u-SIB-ta bi-ma-ra-din fil-ka-bid aw bil-ti-HAA-bil-ka-bid?
translation: هل سبق أن أصبت بمرض في الكبد أو بالتهاب الكبد؟

english: Have your eyes or skin turned yellow?
transliteration: hal is-far-ra lawnu ai-nai-ka aw jil-du-ka?
translation: هل اصفر لون عينيك أو جلدك؟

english: Is your urine darker than usual?
transliteration: hal lawnu baw-li-ka agh-ma-qu mi-nal-mu-taa-d?
translation: هل لون بولك أغمق من المعتاد؟

english: Do you have itching all over your body?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-hik-ka-tin fee ja-mee-i an-HAA-i jis-mik?
translation: هل تشعر بحكة في جميع أنحاء جسمك؟

english: Have you had gallstones?
transliteration: hal kun-ta tu-AA-nee min ta-kaw-wu-nil-ha-SAA fee al-ma-RAA-ra
translation: هَلْ كُنْتَ تُعَانِي مِنْ تَكَوُّنِ الْحَصَى فِي الْمَرَارَة ؟

english: Have you had your gallbladder removed?
transliteration: hal u-ZEE-lat mar-raa-tu-ka?
translation: هل أزيلت المرارة لديك؟

english: Have you ever had pancreatitis?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an u-SIB-ta bil-ti-HAA-bil-ban-kri-yaas?
translation: هل سبق أن أصبت بالتهاب البنكرياس؟

english: Have you noticed swelling in your abdomen or legs?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-war-ru-man fee baT-ni-ka aw saa-QAI-ka?
translation: هل لاحظت تورمًا في بطنك أو ساقيك؟

english: Do you bruise or bleed easily?
transliteration: hal taZ-ha-ru la-DAI-ka-l-ka-dam-maat aw tan-zi-fu bi-su-OO-lah?
translation: هل تظهر لديك الكدمات أو تنزف بسهولة؟

english: Do you have pain around your anus?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-a-la-min haw-lash-sha-raj?
translation: هل تشعر بألم حول الشرج؟

english: Do you have hemorrhoids or piles?
transliteration: hal la-DAI-ka ba-WAA-seer?
translation: هل لديك بواسير؟

english: Do you notice blood on the toilet paper?
transliteration: hal tu-LAA-hi-Zu wu-JOO-da da-min a-la wa-ra-qil-HAM-maam?
translation: هل تلاحظ وجود دم على ورق الحمام؟

english: Do you have itching around your anus?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-hik-ka-tin haw-lash-sha-raj?
translation: هل تشعر بحكة حول الشرج؟

english: Have you noticed a lump near your anus?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta wu-JOO-da kut-la-tin qur-bash-sha-raj?
translation: هل لاحظت وجود كتلة قرب الشرج؟

english: Is there any discharge from your anus?
transliteration: hal takh-ru-ju ay-yu if-raa-ZAAT mi-nash-sha-raj?
translation: هل تخرج أي إفرازات من الشرج؟

english: Do you have pain when passing stool?
transliteration: hal tash-u-ru bi-a-la-min in-dat-tab-ar-ruz?
translation: هل تشعر بألم عند التبرز؟

english: Have you ever had an ulcer in your stomach?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an u-SIB-ta bi-qar-ha-tin fil-ma-i-dah?
translation: هل سبق أن أصبت بقرحة في المعدة؟

english: Have you been diagnosed with Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis?
transliteration: hal shukh-khiS-ta bi-ma-ra-di KROON aw il-ti-HAA-bil-QAW-lu-nit-ta-qar-ru-hi?
translation: هل شُخّصت بمرض كرون أو التهاب القولون التقرحي؟

english: Have you ever had irritable bowel syndrome?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an u-SIB-ta bi-mu-taa-za-ma-til-QAW-lu-nil-a-sa-bi?
translation: هل سبق أن أصبت بمتلازمة القولون العصبي؟

english: Have you had surgery on your abdomen?
transliteration: hal aj-RAI-ta a-ma-li-ya-tan ji-raa-hi-ya-tan fee baT-ni-ka?
translation: هل أجريت عملية جراحية في بطنك؟

english: Have you had your appendix removed?
transliteration: hal u-ZEE-latiz-zaa-i-da-tud-da-DAI-ya-tu la-DAI-ka?
translation: هل أزيلت الزائدة الدودية لديك؟

english: Has anyone in your family had bowel or stomach cancer?
transliteration: hal u-SI-ba a-ha-dun min af-raa-di AA-i-la-ti-ka bi-sa-RA-ta-nil-am-AA-i awil-ma-i-dah?
translation: هل أصيب أحد من أفراد عائلتك بسرطان الأمعاء أو المعدة؟

english: Have you had a colonoscopy before?
transliteration: hal aj-RAI-ta tan-ZEE-ran lil-QAW-luun min QABL?
translation: هل أجريت تنظيرًا للقولون من قبل؟

english: Do you have any food allergies or intolerances?
transliteration: hal la-DAI-ka ay-yi ha-saa-si-ya-tin aw a-dam-ta-HAM-mu-lin li-aT-i-ma-tin mu-ay-ya-nah?
translation: هل لديك أي حساسية أو عدم تحمل لأطعمة معينة؟

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: hal saa-FAR-ta mu-AKH-kha-ran?
translation: هل سافرت مؤخرًا؟

english: Have you eaten any food that may have been spoiled?
transliteration: hal ta-NA-wal-ta ta-AA-man rub-ba-maa ka-na faa-si-dan?
translation: هل تناولت طعامًا ربما كان فاسدًا؟

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: maa-l-ad-WI-ya-tul-la-tee ta-ta-NA-wa-lu-haa bi-in-ti-ZAAM?
translation: ما الأدوية التي تتناولها بانتظام؟

english: Do you take ibuprofen, naproxen, or aspirin?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NA-wa-lu ibuprofen aw naproxen aw aspirin?
translation: هل تتناول ibuprofen أو naproxen أو aspirin؟

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NA-wa-lu ad-WI-ya-tan mu-may-yi-a-tan lid-DAM?
translation: هل تتناول أدوية مميعة للدم؟

english: Have you taken antibiotics recently?
transliteration: hal ta-NA-wal-ta mu-DA-daat ha-YA-wi-yah mu-AKH-kha-ran?
translation: هل تناولت مضادات حيوية مؤخرًا؟

english: Have you started any new medicine or supplement?
transliteration: hal ba-da-ta bi-ta-NA-wu-li da-waa-in aw mu-kam-mil ja-deed?
translation: هل بدأت بتناول دواء أو مكمل جديد؟

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: hal tash-ra-bul-ku-HOOL
translation: هِلْ تَشْرُبُ الْكُحُول ؟

english: How much alcohol do you usually drink in a week?
transliteration: kam-mi-ya-tul-ku-HOOL-il-la-tee tash-ra-bu-haa AA-da-tan fil-us-BOO?
translation: كمية الكحول التي تشربها عادةً في الأسبوع؟

english: Have you ever had problems because of alcohol?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an waa-jaHTa mush-ki-laa-tin bi-sa-ba-bil-ku-HOOL?
translation: هل سبق أن واجهت مشكلات بسبب الكحول؟

english: Is your abdominal pain severe right now?
transliteration: hal a-la-mu baT-ni-ka sha-deed al-AAN?
translation: هل ألم بطنك شديد الآن؟

english: Is your abdomen hard or very tender to touch?
transliteration: hal baT-nu-ka QAA-sin aw sha-deedul-ha-saa-si-ya-ti in-da lam-si-hi?
translation: هل بطنك قاسٍ أو شديد الحساسية عند لمسه؟

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: hal ugh-mi-ya a-LAI-ka aw sha-ar-ta bi-du-KHA-tin sha-deed?
translation: هل أُغمي عليك أو شعرت بدوار شديد؟

english: Are you vomiting blood?
transliteration: hal ta-TA-QAY-ya-u da-man?
translation: هل تتقيأ دمًا؟

english: Are you passing black, tarry stool?
transliteration: hal takh-ru-ju ba-raa-zan AS-wa-da qi-TRA-ni-yan?
translation: هل تخرج برازًا أسود قطرانيًا؟

english: Are you passing a large amount of blood in your stool?
transliteration: hal yakh-ru-ju ma-a ba-raa-zi-ka miq-DAA-run ka-BEER minad-DAM?
translation: هل يخرج مع برازك مقدار كبير من الدم؟

english: Are you unable to pass stool or gas?
transliteration: hal laa tas-ta-TEE-u ikh-RAA-jal-ba-RAAZ awil-GAA-zaat?
translation: هل لا تستطيع إخراج البراز أو الغازات؟

english: Have you stopped passing urine or are you urinating much less?
transliteration: hal ta-waq-fa khuroo-jul-BAWL la-DAI-ka aw as-baHTa ta-ta-BAW-wa-lu aqal-la bi-ka-theer?
translation: هل توقف خروج البول لديك أو أصبحت تتبول أقل بكثير؟

english: Do you have fever with severe abdominal pain?
transliteration: hal la-DAI-ka hu-MAA ma-a a-la-min SHA-dee-din fil-baTn?
translation: هل لديك حمى مع ألم شديد في البطن؟

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: hal hu-naa-ka ih-ti-MAA-lun an ta-koo-nee HAA-mi-lan?
translation: هل هناك احتمال أن تكوني حاملًا؟

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: min FAD-li-ka is-ta-LEE a-la ZAH-rik.
translation: من فضلك استلقِ على ظهرك.

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: min FAD-li-ka ith-nee ruk-ba-tai-ka qa-LEE-lan.
translation: من فضلك اثنِ ركبتيك قليلًا.

english: Please lift your shirt so I can examine your abdomen.
transliteration: min FAD-li-ka ir-fa qa-MI-sa-ka hat-TAA a-ta-MAK-ka-na min fah-SI baT-ni-ka.
translation: من فضلك ارفع قميصك حتى أتمكن من فحص بطنك.

english: I am going to listen to your abdomen.
transliteration: sa-as-ta-mi-u i-la as-WAA-ti baT-ni-ka.
translation: سأستمع إلى أصوات بطنك.

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: sa-aD-gha-Tu bi-RIFQ a-la baT-ni-ka.
translation: سأضغط برفق على بطنك.

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: akh-bir-nee i-dhaa sha-ar-ta bi-a-la-min in-da-maa aD-gha-Tu HAA-na.
translation: أخبرني إذا شعرت بألم عندما أضغط هنا.

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?
transliteration: hal yaz-daa-dul-a-la-mu in-da-maa ar-fa-u ya-dee?
translation: هل يزداد الألم عندما أرفع يدي؟

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: min FAD-li-ka khudh na-FA-san a-MI-qan.
translation: من فضلك خذ نفسًا عميقًا.

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.
transliteration: qad ah-TAA-ju i-la fah-SI-lmus-ta-QEEM, wa-sa-u-FAS-si-ru la-kas-sa-ba-ba AWW-a-lan.
translation: قد أحتاج إلى فحص المستقيم، وسأشرح لك السبب أولًا.

english: We would like to do some blood tests.
transliteration: na-WAD-du ij-RAA-a ba-di fa-HOO-SAA-tid-DAM.
translation: نود إجراء بعض فحوصات الدم.

english: We need a stool sample.
transliteration: nah-TAA-ju i-la AAAY-yi-na-tin mi-nal-ba-RAAZ.
translation: نحتاج إلى عينة من البراز.

english: Please collect a stool sample in this container.
transliteration: min FAD-li-ka ij-ma AAAY-yi-na-tan mi-nal-ba-RAAZ fee HAA-dhil-hi-waa-yah.
translation: من فضلك اجمع عينة من البراز في هذه الحاوية.

english: We may need an ultrasound of your abdomen.
transliteration: qad nah-TAA-ju i-la ij-RAA-i taS-WEER bil-maw-JAAT faw-qas-saw-ti-yah li-baT-ni-ka.
translation: قد نحتاج إلى إجراء تصوير بالموجات فوق الصوتية لبطنك.

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: qad nah-TAA-ju i-la ij-RAA-i taS-WEER miq-TA-i-yin li-baT-ni-ka.
translation: قد نحتاج إلى إجراء تصوير مقطعي لبطنك.

english: A gastroscopy uses a small camera to look inside your food pipe and stomach.
transliteration: yas-ta-KHdi-mu tan-ZEER-ul-mi-i-dah ka-ME-ra Sa-GHEE-ra-tan lifah-SI-lmi-REE-i wal-mi-i-da-ti minid-DAA-khil.
translation: يستخدم تنظير المعدة كاميرا صغيرة لفحص المريء والمعدة من الداخل.

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.
transliteration: yas-ta-KHdi-mu tan-ZEER-ul-QAW-luun ka-ME-ra lifah-SI-lam-AA-i-lgha-LEE-za-ti minid-DAA-khil.
translation: يستخدم تنظير القولون كاميرا لفحص الأمعاء الغليظة من الداخل.

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.
transliteration: qad tah-TAA-ju i-la ta-NA-wu-li taH-DHEE-rin lil-am-AA-i qab-la tan-ZEER-il-QAW-luun.
translation: قد تحتاج إلى تناول تحضير للأمعاء قبل تنظير القولون.

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.
transliteration: qad tah-TAA-ju i-lal-im-ti-NAA-i anil-AKL awish-shurb qab-lal-ij-RAA.
translation: قد تحتاج إلى الامتناع عن الأكل أو الشرب قبل الإجراء.

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: sa-nu-sha-ri-hul-ma-KHAA-ti-ra wa-naT-lu-bu mu-waa-fa-qa-ta-ka qab-lal-ij-RAA.
translation: سنشرح المخاطر ونطلب موافقتك قبل الإجراء.

english: We will give you fluids to prevent dehydration.
transliteration: sa-nu-TEE-ka su-waa-il lil-wi-QAA-ya-ti mi-nal-ja-FAAF.
translation: سنعطيك سوائل للوقاية من الجفاف.

english: Take small sips of water frequently.
transliteration: ish-rab rash-faatin Sa-GHEE-ra-tan mi-nal-MAA-i bi-shak-lin mu-ta-KAR-rir.
translation: اشرب رشفات صغيرة من الماء بشكل متكرر.

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: ta-NA-wal HAA-dhad-da-WAA-a has-banil-was-fah.
translation: تناول هذا الدواء حسب الوصفة.

english: This medicine may help reduce stomach acid.
transliteration: qad yu-saa-i-du HAA-dhad-da-WAA-u a-la ta-QLEEL ha-mi-Dil-mi-i-dah.
translation: قد يساعد هذا الدواء على تقليل حمض المعدة.

english: Avoid foods that make your symptoms worse.
transliteration: ta-JAN-nab-il-aT-i-ma-tal-la-tee ta-ZEE-du a-RAA-Da-ka SOO-an.
translation: تجنب الأطعمة التي تزيد أعراضك سوءًا.

english: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen unless your clinician advises it.
transliteration: laa ta-ta-NA-wal mas-sa-ki-NAATil-a-lam miTH-la ibuprofen il-laa i-dhaa na-sa-ha-kaT-TA-beeb bi-dhaa-lik.
translation: لا تتناول مسكنات الألم مثل ibuprofen إلا إذا نصحك الطبيب بذلك.

english: We may refer you to a digestive system specialist.
transliteration: qad nu-HEE-lu-ka i-la ik-ti-SAA-SI-yin fee-lji-HAA-zil-haD-mi.
translation: قد نحيلك إلى اختصاصي في الجهاز الهضمي.

english: If you develop severe pain or bleeding, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: i-tha sha-ART-a bi-A-lam sha-DEED aw HA-da-tha na-ZEEF, fa-TLUB ri-A-ya TIB-biy-ya AA-ji-la.
translation: إذا شعرت بألم شديد أو حدث نزيف، فاطلب رعاية طبية عاجلة.

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka ay-YU AS-i-la?
translation: هل لديك أي أسئلة؟

english: Can you tell me what symptoms would make you seek urgent help?
transliteration: hal yum-ki-nu-ka an TUK-bi-ra-nee ma al-a-RAAD al-la-tee qad taj-A-lu-ka TUT-lub mu-SAA-a-da AA-ji-la?
translation: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني ما الأعراض التي قد تجعلك تطلب مساعدة عاجلة؟

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: sa-nu-RAT-tib la-ka maw-i-dan lil-mu-TAA-ba-a.
translation: سنرتب لك موعدًا للمتابعة.

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: yur-JAA al-aW-da i-tha iz-DAA-dat al-a-RAAD SOO-an.
translation: يرجى العودة إذا ازدادت الأعراض سوءًا.

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: SHUK-ran la-ka a-la at-ta-HAD-duth ma-AA-ya al-YAWM.
translation: شكرًا لك على التحدث معي اليوم.

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: mar-HA-ban, A-na UDW fi fa-REEQ ar-ri-AA-ya as-siH-HEE-ya al-KHAAS bik.
translation: مرحبًا، أنا عضو في فريق الرعاية الصحية الخاص بك.

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: ma al-la-thee A-taa bi-ka i-LAA hu-na al-YAWM?
translation: ما الذي أتى بك إلى هنا اليوم؟

english: I would like to ask some questions about your urinary health.
transliteration: a-WUDD an AT-ra-ha a-LAY-ka baA-da al-AS-i-la an SIH-hat ji-HAA-zik al-baw-LEE.
translation: أود أن أطرح عليك بعض الأسئلة عن صحة جهازك البولي.

english: Some questions may be personal; is that okay?
transliteration: qad ta-KOON baA-du al-AS-i-la shakh-SEY-ya; hal haa-tha maq-BOOL?
translation: قد تكون بعض الأسئلة شخصية؛ هل هذا مقبول؟

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: hal taS-maH lee bi-FAH-SHik?
translation: هل تسمح لي بفحصك؟

english: Would you like a chaperone present for the examination?
transliteration: hal ta-WADD wu-JOOD mu-RAA-fiq ath-NAA al-FAHS?
translation: هل تود وجود مرافق أثناء الفحص؟

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: hal taH-taaJ i-LAA mu-tar-Jim sha-FA-hee?
translation: هل تحتاج إلى مترجم شفهي؟

english: When did the problem begin?
transliteration: ma-TAA ba-da-at al-mush-KI-la?
translation: متى بدأت المشكلة؟

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hal ba-da-at faj-A-tan am ta-dree-JEE-yan?
translation: هل بدأت فجأة أم تدريجيًا؟

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: mun-thu ma-TAA tu-AA-nee min haa-thi al-a-RAAD?
translation: منذ متى تعاني من هذه الأعراض؟

english: Are the symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-HAS-san al-a-RAAD am ta-SOO?
translation: هل تتحسن الأعراض أم تسوء؟

english: Does the problem come and go?
transliteration: hal taA-tee al-mush-KI-la wa ta-ZOOL?
translation: هل تأتي المشكلة وتزول؟

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: hal sa-BAQ an AA-nee-ta min haa-thi al-mush-KI-la?
translation: هل سبق أن عانيت من هذه المشكلة؟

english: What concerns you most about these symptoms?
transliteration: ma AK-thar ma yu-qal-li-qu-ka bi-SHA-an haa-thi al-a-RAAD?
translation: ما أكثر ما يقلقك بشأن هذه الأعراض؟

english: Are you urinating more often than usual?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-BAW-wal AK-thar min al-mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تتبول أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: How many times do you urinate during the day?
transliteration: kam MAR-ra ta-ta-BAW-wal khi-LAAL an-na-HAAR?
translation: كم مرة تتبول خلال النهار؟

english: How many times do you wake at night to urinate?
transliteration: kam MAR-ra tas-TAI-qiz LAY-lan lit-ta-BAW-wul?
translation: كم مرة تستيقظ ليلًا للتبول؟

english: Do you suddenly feel an urgent need to urinate?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru faj-A-tan bi-HAA-ja MUL-hha ilat-ta-BAW-wul?
translation: هل تشعر فجأة بحاجة ملحة إلى التبول؟

english: Can you hold your urine until you reach the toilet?
transliteration: hal yum-ki-nu-ka HABS al-BAWL HAT-ta ta-SIL i-LAA al-mir-HAAD?
translation: هل يمكنك حبس البول حتى تصل إلى المرحاض؟

english: Are you passing more urine than usual?
transliteration: hal TUK-ri-j kam-MI-yat bawl AK-thar min al-mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تخرج كمية بول أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Are you passing less urine than usual?
transliteration: hal TUK-ri-j kam-MI-yat bawl A-qall min al-mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تخرج كمية بول أقل من المعتاد؟

english: When did you last pass urine?
transliteration: ma-TAA ta-BAWWALT AA-khir MAR-ra?
translation: متى تبولت آخر مرة؟

english: Does it burn or hurt when you urinate?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru bi-HA-ra-qa aw A-lam in-da at-ta-BAW-wul?
translation: هل تشعر بحرقة أو ألم عند التبول؟

english: Do you have pain in your lower abdomen?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka A-lam fee as-faL al-batn?
translation: هل تشعر بألم في أسفل البطن؟

english: Do you have fever or chills?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka HU-ma aw qar-A-ree-ra?
translation: هل لديك حمى أو قشعريرة؟

english: Is your urine cloudy?
transliteration: hal yab-DOO baw-lu-ka AA-kir-an?
translation: هل يبدو بولك عكرًا؟

english: Does your urine have a strong or unusual smell?
transliteration: hal li-baw-li-ka RAA-i-ha qa-WI-ya aw ghayr mu-TAA-da?
translation: هل لبولك رائحة قوية أو غير معتادة؟

english: Have you noticed blood in your urine?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta wu-JOOD damm fee baw-li-ka?
translation: هل لاحظت وجود دم في بولك؟

english: Is your urine pink, red, or brown?
transliteration: hal LAW-nu baw-li-ka war-DEE aw AH-mar aw BUN-nee?
translation: هل لون بولك وردي أو أحمر أو بني؟

english: Have you noticed foam in your urine?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta wu-JOOD rag-WA fi baw-li-ka?
translation: هل لاحظت وجود رغوة في بولك؟

english: Have you had a urinary tract infection before?
transliteration: hal sa-BAQ an u-SIB-ta bi-ad-WA fee al-ma-SAA-lik al-baw-LEE-ya?
translation: هل سبق أن أصبت بعدوى في المسالك البولية؟

english: Have you taken antibiotics for this problem?
transliteration: hal ta-NAA-walt mu-DAD-daat ha-yaw-EE-ya li-haa-thi al-mush-KI-la?
translation: هل تناولت مضادات حيوية لهذه المشكلة؟

english: Is it difficult to start urinating?
transliteration: hal ta-JID su-OO-ba fee BAD al-ta-BAW-wul?
translation: هل تجد صعوبة في بدء التبول؟

english: Is your urine stream weaker than before?
transliteration: hal AS-baH ta-daf-fuq al-BAWL AD-af min qabl?
translation: هل أصبح تدفق البول أضعف من قبل؟

english: Does your urine stream stop and start?
transliteration: hal ya-ta-WAQ-qaf ta-daf-fuq al-BAWL thum-ma yab-DA min ja-DEED?
translation: هل يتوقف تدفق البول ثم يبدأ من جديد؟

english: Do you have to strain to urinate?
transliteration: hal taD-TAR ilal-HAZQ lit-ta-BAW-wul?
translation: هل تضطر إلى الحزق للتبول؟

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: yum-ki-nu-na at-ta-waq-quf qa-LEEL-an aw in-HAA al-faHS fee ay-yi waqt.
translation: يمكننا التوقف قليلًا أو إنهاء الفحص في أي وقت.

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: qad ya-koon faHS al-bu-ROOS-taa-taa mu-FEED-an; sa-ash-ra-Hu la-ka aw-wa-lan.
translation: قد يكون فحص البروستاتا مفيدًا؛ سأشرحه لك أولًا.

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: qad ya-ta-DAM-man faHS al-bu-ROOS-taa-taa id-KHAA-lu is-baa muR-ta-di-yan qi-FAAZ-an fil-mus-ta-QUEEM.
translation: قد يتضمن فحص البروستاتا إدخال إصبع مرتدٍ قفازًا في المستقيم.

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: hal tu-WAA-fiq a-LAA ij-RAA haa-tha al-FAHS?
translation: هل توافق على إجراء هذا الفحص؟

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: hal tar-ghab fee wu-JOOD mu-RAA-fiq ath-NAA haa-tha al-FAHS?
translation: هل ترغب في وجود مرافق أثناء هذا الفحص؟

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: min faD-lik is-ta-dir i-LAA JAA-ni-bik.
translation: من فضلك استدر إلى جانبك.

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: min faD-lik ith-ni ruk-ba-TAY-ka bit-ti-JAAH SAD-rik.
translation: من فضلك اثنِ ركبتيك باتجاه صدرك.

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: sa-a-ta-HAA-qaq min wu-JOOD ta-war-rum aw A-lam in-da lamS kayS as-safn.
translation: سأتحقق من وجود تورم أو ألم عند لمس كيس الصفن.

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: min faD-lik is-A-l bay-na-maa af-HAS min-TA-qat al-ar-bi-ya.
translation: من فضلك اسعل بينما أفحص منطقة الأربية.

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: naH-taaJ i-LAA ay-yi-na min al-BAWL.
translation: نحتاج إلى عينة من البول.

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: min faD-lik ij-ma al-BAWL fee haa-thih al-ib-REE-qa an-na-ZEE-fa.
translation: من فضلك اجمع البول في هذه العبوة النظيفة.

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: sa-naf-HAS baw-la-ka lil-kashf an al-il-ti-haaB wad-damm.
translation: سنفحص بولك للكشف عن الالتهاب والدم.

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: qad nur-sil ay-yi-nat al-BAWL li-ij-RAA maz-RA-a.
translation: قد نرسل عينة البول لإجراء مزرعة.

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: nu-REED faHS wa-ZAA-if al-ki-LAA la-DAY-ka an TAA-reeq taH-LEEL ad-damm.
translation: نود فحص وظائف الكلى لديك عن طريق تحليل الدم.

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: qad nu-rat-tib li-ij-RAA taS-weer bil-maw-JAAT fawq as-saw-TEE-ya lil-ki-lay-TAYN wal-math-THA-na.
translation: قد نرتب لإجراء تصوير بالموجات فوق الصوتية للكليتين والمثانة.

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: qad naH-taaJ i-LAA ij-RAA taS-weer maq-TA-ee lil-baHth an haS-a al-ki-LAA.
translation: قد نحتاج إلى إجراء تصوير مقطعي للبحث عن حصى الكلى.

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: qad na-ta-HAA-qaq min kam-MI-yat al-BAWL al-mu-ta-baQ-QI-ya fil-math-THA-na baA-da at-ta-BAW-wul.
translation: قد نتحقق من كمية البول المتبقية في المثانة بعد التبول.

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: qad naH-taaJ i-LAA faHS al-math-THA-na bi-kaa-mee-ra, wa-yu-sam-MAA tan-ZEER al-math-THA-na.
translation: قد نحتاج إلى فحص المثانة بكاميرا، ويُسمى تنظير المثانة.

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: qad naH-taaJ i-LAA iA-TAA-ik mu-DAD-daat ha-yaw-EE-ya.
translation: قد نحتاج إلى إعطائك مضادات حيوية.

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: min faD-lik ta-NA-wal haa-tha ad-da-WAA ta-MAA-man ka-maa wu-SIF la-ka.
translation: من فضلك تناول هذا الدواء تمامًا كما وُصف لك.

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: qad taH-taaJ i-LAA qis-TA-ra li-taS-REEF al-BAWL min al-math-THA-na.
translation: قد تحتاج إلى قسطرة لتصريف البول من المثانة.

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: sa-nash-raH la-ka ij-RAA tar-KEEB al-qis-TA-ra wa-naT-lub mu-WAA-fa-qa-tak.
translation: سنشرح لك إجراء تركيب القسطرة ونطلب موافقتك.

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: min faD-lik ab-QI kayS al-qis-TA-ra as-faL mus-ta-WAA al-math-THA-na.
translation: من فضلك أبقِ كيس القسطرة أسفل مستوى المثانة.

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: qad taH-taaJ i-LAA taS-fi-yat al-BAWL li-jam-i al-HA-sa.
translation: قد تحتاج إلى تصفية البول لجمع الحصوة.

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: qad nu-HEEL-ka i-LAA ta-BEEB ma-SAA-lik baw-LEE-ya.
translation: قد نحيلك إلى طبيب مسالك بولية.

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: qad nu-HEEL-ka i-LAA ik-ti-SAA-see ki-LAA.
translation: قد نحيلك إلى اختصاصي كلى.

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: i-tha lam tas-ta-TEE-u at-ta-BAW-wul aw u-SIB-ta bi-A-lam sha-DEED aw HU-ma, fa-TLUB ri-AA-ya TIB-biy-ya AA-ji-la.
translation: إذا لم تستطع التبول أو أصبت بألم شديد أو حمى، فاطلب رعاية طبية عاجلة.

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka ay-YU AS-i-la?
translation: هل لديك أي أسئلة؟

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: hal yum-ki-nu-ka an TUK-bi-ra-nee ma al-a-RAAD al-la-tee tas-ta-DEE-u i-NAA-ya TIB-biy-ya AA-ji-la?
translation: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني ما الأعراض التي تستدعي عناية طبية عاجلة؟

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: sa-nu-RAT-tib maw-i-dan lil-mu-TAA-ba-a.
translation: سنرتب موعدًا للمتابعة.

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: min faD-lik UD i-tha saa-at a-RAA-Duk.
translation: من فضلك عُد إذا ساءت أعراضك.

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: SHUK-ran la-ka a-la at-ta-HAD-duth ma-AA-ya al-YAWM.
translation: شكرًا لك على التحدث معي اليوم.

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: ma al-la-thee A-taa bi-ka al-YAWM?
translation: ما الذي أتى بك اليوم؟

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: ma-TAA ba-da-at a-RAA-Duk?
translation: متى بدأت أعراضك؟

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: hal iz-DAA-dat a-RAA-Duk SOO-an?
translation: هل ازدادت أعراضك سوءًا؟

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka ay-yu a-RAAD ukH-raa?
translation: هل لديك أي أعراض أخرى؟

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: hal taS-maH lee an as-a-la-ka an taa-REE-khik aT-TIB-bee?
translation: هل تسمح لي أن أسألك عن تاريخك الطبي؟

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: hal taS-maH lee bi-FAH-SHik?
translation: هل تسمح لي بفحصك؟

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: hal tar-ghab fil-is-ti-AA-na bi-mu-tar-Jim sha-FA-hee?
translation: هل ترغب في الاستعانة بمترجم شفهي؟

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: hal shukh-KHIS-ta bi-ma-raD as-suk-KA-ree?
translation: هل شُخّصت بمرض السكري؟

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka suk-KA-ree min an-naw al-aw-wal am ath-thaa-nee?
translation: هل لديك سكري من النوع الأول أم الثاني؟

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: mun-thu ma-TAA wa-an-ta mu-SAB bis-suk-KA-ree?
translation: منذ متى وأنت مصاب بالسكري؟

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru bi-aTASH AK-thar min al-mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تشعر بعطش أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-BAW-wal AK-thar min al-mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تتبول أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: hal tas-TAI-qiz LAY-lan lit-ta-BAW-wul?
translation: هل تستيقظ ليلًا للتبول؟

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: hal fa-QADT waz-nan min DOON an tu-HAA-wil?
translation: هل فقدت وزنًا من دون أن تحاول؟

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru bi-JOO ak-thar min al-mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تشعر بجوع أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-shaw-wu-shan fir-ru-YA?
translation: هل لاحظت تشوشًا في الرؤية؟

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru bi-taA-b ghayr mu-TAA-d?
translation: هل تشعر بتعب غير معتاد؟

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: hal u-SIB-ta bil-ti-haa-BAAT mu-ta-kar-ri-ra?
translation: هل أُصبت بالتهابات متكررة؟

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: hal tas-taghr-riH ju-ROO-Huk waqtan ta-wee-lan li-tal-ta-im?
translation: هل تستغرق جروحك وقتًا طويلًا لتلتئم؟

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: hal taf-HAS mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar fee da-mik fil-MAN-zil?
translation: هل تفحص مستوى السكر في دمك في المنزل؟

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: kam MAR-ra taf-HAS mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar fee da-mik?
translation: كم مرة تفحص مستوى السكر في دمك؟

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: ma aa-khir qi-RA-a li-mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar fee da-mik?
translation: ما آخر قراءة لمستوى السكر في دمك؟

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: hal tas-taK-dim ji-HAA-zan li-mu-raa-qa-bat mus-ta-WAA al-jloo-KOOZ bi-is-ti-MRAAR?
translation: هل تستخدم جهازًا لمراقبة مستوى الجلوكوز باستمرار؟

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: hal aH-DAR-ta qi-RA-aaT mus-ta-WAA al-jloo-KOOZ la-DAY-ka?
translation: هل أحضرت قراءات مستوى الجلوكوز لديك؟

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: hal aj-ray-ta taH-LEEL damm lil-hee-mo-GLO-bin as-suk-KA-ree Hb-A-one-see?
translation: هل أجريت تحليل دم للهيموغلوبين السكري HbA1c؟

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: sa-naf-HAS mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar fee da-mik al-AAN.
translation: سنفحص مستوى السكر في دمك الآن.

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar fee da-mik aA-la min al-mus-ta-WAA al-mus-ta-HAD-daf.
translation: مستوى السكر في دمك أعلى من المستوى المستهدف.

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: hal tu-AA-nee min naq-sis-suk-ka-ri fid-DAM
translation: هَلْ تُعَانِي مِنْ نَقْصِ السُّكَّرِ فِي الدَّمِ ؟

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru bi-raj-fa aw ta-ta-ar-raq in-da-maa yan-KHA-fiD mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar la-DAY-ka?
translation: هل تشعر برجفة أو تتعرق عندما ينخفض مستوى السكر لديك؟

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: hal tash-A-ru bid-da-WA-kha aw at-ta-shaw-wush in-da-maa yan-KHA-fiD mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar la-DAY-ka?
translation: هل تشعر بالدوخة أو التشوش عندما ينخفض مستوى السكر لديك؟

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: hal sa-BAQ an ugh-mee a-LAY-ka bi-sa-bab in-KHI-faaD mus-ta-WAA as-suk-kar fee da-mik?
translation: هل سبق أن أُغمي عليك بسبب انخفاض مستوى السكر في دمك؟

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: MAA-THAA taf-AA-lu IN-da-maa yan-KHA-fi-du mus-ta-WAA as-SUK-kar fee DA-mik?
translation: ماذا تفعل عندما ينخفض مستوى السكر في دمك؟

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: hal TAH-mi-lu ma-A-k shaY-an HUL-wan?
translation: هل تحمل معك شيئًا حلوًا؟

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: hal ir-ta-fa-a mus-ta-WAA as-SUK-kar fee DA-mik ka-THEE-ran mu-AK-kha-ran?
translation: هل ارتفع مستوى السكر في دمك كثيرًا مؤخرًا؟

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: hal sha-A-rta bil-GHA-tha-yan aw ta-QAY-ya-ta aw sha-A-rta bi-A-lam fil-MA-i-da?
translation: هل شعرت بالغثيان أو تقيأت أو شعرت بألم في المعدة؟

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NAF-fa-su bi-SUR-a ak-bar aw bi-UMQ ak-bar min al-mu-TAAD?
translation: هل تتنفس بسرعة أكبر أو بعمق أكبر من المعتاد؟

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an da-KHAL-ta al-mus-tash-FAA bi-SA-bab al-ha-MAAD al-kee-TOO-nee as-SUK-ka-ree?
translation: هل سبق أن دخلت المستشفى بسبب الحماض الكيتوني السكري؟

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: ma al-ad-WI-ya al-la-tee ta-ta-NA-wa-lu-ha li-i-LAAJ as-SUK-ka-ree?
translation: ما الأدوية التي تتناولها لعلاج السكري؟

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NA-wa-lu aq-RAA-san li-i-LAAJ as-SUK-ka-ree?
translation: هل تتناول أقراصًا لعلاج السكري؟

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: hal tas-ta-KH-dim al-an-su-LEEN?
translation: هل تستخدم الأنسولين؟

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: kam WAH-da min al-an-su-LEEN ta-ta-NA-wa-lu?
translation: كم وحدة من الأنسولين تتناول؟

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: ma-TAA ta-ta-NA-wa-lu al-an-su-LEEN?
translation: متى تتناول الأنسولين؟

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: hal ta-na-WAL-ta al-an-su-LEEN al-YAWM?
translation: هل تناولت الأنسولين اليوم؟

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: hal faa-ta-tak ay JUR-aat mu-AK-kha-ran?
translation: هل فاتتك أي جرعات مؤخرًا؟

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: hal tas-ta-KH-dim qa-la-man aw DAM-kha lil-an-su-LEEN?
translation: هل تستخدم قلمًا أو مضخة للأنسولين؟

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: AY-na ta-HQIN al-an-su-LEEN?
translation: أين تحقن الأنسولين؟

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: hal ta-GHAY-yir ma-WAA-di-a al-HAQN?
translation: هل تغيّر مواضع الحقن؟

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: hal ZHA-ha-rat la-day-ka AA-thaar JAA-ni-bi-ya min ad-WI-ya-tik?
translation: هل ظهرت لديك آثار جانبية من أدويتك؟

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: hal TAR-gha-bu an U-ri-ya-ka kay-fi-ya-t HAQN al-an-su-LEEN?
translation: هل ترغب أن أريك كيفية حقن الأنسولين؟

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bil-KHA-dar aw al-WAKZ fee QAA-da-mayk?
translation: هل تشعر بالخدر أو الوخز في قدميك؟

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-A-lam HAA-riq fee QAA-da-mayk?
translation: هل تشعر بألم حارق في قدميك؟

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ay ta-qa-RU-haat fee QAA-da-mayk?
translation: هل لاحظت أي تقرحات في قدميك؟

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: hal taf-HAS QAA-da-mayk kul YAWM?
translation: هل تفحص قدميك كل يوم؟

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: hal aj-RAAY-ta FAS-han lil-AIN bi-SA-bab as-SUK-ka-ree?
translation: هل أجريت فحصًا للعين بسبب السكري؟

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: hal ATH-tha-ra as-SUK-ka-ree fil-KIL-ya-tayn?
translation: هل أثّر السكري في كليتيك؟

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: hal u-SIB-ta bi-NAW-ba QAL-bi-ya aw bi-SAK-ta DIM-ghaa-ghi-ya?
translation: هل أصبت بنوبة قلبية أو بسكتة دماغية؟

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: sa-AF-has al-ih-SAAS fee QAA-da-mayk.
translation: سأفحص الإحساس في قدميك.

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-HAA-tha AA-la a-SAA-bi QAA-da-mayk?
translation: هل تشعر بهذا على أصابع قدميك؟

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an AA-ney-ta min mush-ki-la fee al-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya?
translation: هل سبق أن عانيت من مشكلة في الغدة الدرقية؟

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka qu-SOOR fil-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya?
translation: هل لديك قصور في الغدة الدرقية؟

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka fa-RAT fee na-SHAAT al-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya?
translation: هل لديك فرط في نشاط الغدة الدرقية؟

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bil-BARD ak-thar min al-mu-TAAD?
translation: هل تشعر بالبرد أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-HARR sha-deed aw ta-ta-ARRA-qu ak-thar min al-mu-TAAD?
translation: هل تشعر بحر شديد أو تتعرق أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-saa-ru-an fee da-ra-BAAT QAL-bik?
translation: هل لاحظت تسارعًا في ضربات قلبك؟

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ir-ti-AA-shan fee ya-dayk?
translation: هل لاحظت ارتعاشًا في يديك؟

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: hal u-SIB-ta bil-im-SAAK?
translation: هل أصبت بالإمساك؟

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: hal as-BAH-ta ta-ta-bar-ra-zu ka-THEE-ran?
translation: هل أصبحت تتبرز كثيرًا؟

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-war-ru-man fee ra-QA-ba-tik?
translation: هل لاحظت تورمًا في رقبتك؟

english: Is it difficult to swallow?

english: What do you usually eat in a day?

english: How often do you exercise?

english: Do you drink sugary drinks?

english: Would you like help with weight management?

english: Have you ever broken a bone after a minor fall?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had a bone density scan?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you take calcium or vitamin D?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NA-wa-lu al-KAL-syum aw fee-ta-MEEN D?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had kidney stones?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D

english: Do you have tingling around your mouth or fingers?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been diagnosed with a parathyroid problem?

english: Have you ever had a problem with your adrenal glands?
transliteration: hal sa-BA-qa an AA-ney-ta min mush-ki-la fee al-ghu-DAD al-ka-ZA-ri-ya?

english: Do you take steroid medicines such as prednisone?

translation: هل تتناول أدوية من نوع الستيرويدات مثل prednisone؟

english: How long have you been taking steroids?
transliteration: mun-dhu ma-TAA wa-an-ta ta-ta-NA-wa-lu as-ste-RO-yds?

english: Have you recently stopped taking steroids?
transliteration: hal ta-waQ-QAF-ta mu-AK-kha-ran an ta-ta-NA-wa-lu as-ste-RO-yds?

english: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bid-da-WAAR in-da-maa ta-QIF?
translation: هل تشعر بالدوار عندما تقف؟

english: Have you noticed darker patches of skin?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta bi-QA-an daa-ki-na AA-la JIL-dik?
translation: هل لاحظت بقعًا داكنة على جلدك؟

english: Do you crave salty foods?
transliteration: hal tash-ta-hee al-at-i-ma al-maa-li-ha?
translation: هل تشتهي الأطعمة المالحة؟

english: Have you noticed easy bruising or purple stretch marks?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta zu-hoor ku-doo-maat bi-su-hooda aw khu-TOOT ta-mad-dud bun-na-ji-ya?
translation: هل لاحظت ظهور كدمات بسهولة أو خطوط تمدد بنفسجية؟

english: Do you have an emergency steroid plan?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka khit-tat ta-WAA-ri li-is-tikh-DAAM as-ste-RO-yds?
translation: هل لديك خطة طوارئ لاستخدام الستيرويدات؟

english: Have you had persistent headaches or changes in vision?
transliteration: hal AA-ney-ta min su-DAA musta-MIR aw ta-ghay-yu-RAAT fir-ru-YA?
translation: هل عانيت من صداع مستمر أو تغيرات في الرؤية؟

english: Have your periods become irregular or stopped?
transliteration: hal as-BA-hat daw-ra-tuk ash-shah-REE-ya ghayr mun-ta-ZA-ma aw ta-waq-qa-fat?
translation: هل أصبحت دورتك الشهرية غير منتظمة أو توقفت؟

english: Have you noticed unexpected milk discharge from your breasts?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta khu-ROOJ ha-LEEB min thad-YAYK doon ta-waQ-qu?
translation: هل لاحظت خروج حليب من ثدييك دون توقع؟

english: Have you noticed changes in sexual desire?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-ghay-yu-ran fee ragh-ba-tik al-JIN-si-ya?
translation: هل لاحظت تغيرًا في رغبتك الجنسية؟

english: Have you had problems with erections?
transliteration: hal waa-jaht mush-ki-LAAT fil-in-ti-SAA-b?
translation: هل واجهت مشكلات في الانتصاب؟

english: Have you noticed increased facial or body hair?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta zi-YAA-da fee shaA-ri waj-hik aw jis-mik?
translation: هل لاحظت زيادة في شعر وجهك أو جسمك؟

english: Have you noticed unusual acne or hair loss?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta hub shabaab ghayr mu-TAAD aw ta-SAA-quT ash-shaA-r?
translation: هل لاحظت حب شباب غير معتاد أو تساقط الشعر؟

english: Have you had difficulty becoming pregnant?
transliteration: hal waa-jaht su-U-ba fil-HAML?
translation: هل واجهت صعوبة في الحمل؟

english: Are you taking any hormone treatment?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NA-wa-lu ay i-LAAJ har-MO-nee?
translation: هل تتناول أي علاج هرموني؟

english: Does anyone in your family have diabetes?
transliteration: hal yu-AA-nee a-ha-dun fee AA-i-la-tik min as-SUK-ka-ree?
translation: هل يعاني أحد في عائلتك من السكري؟

english: Does anyone in your family have thyroid disease?
transliteration: hal yu-AA-nee a-ha-dun fee AA-i-la-tik min ma-RAD fil-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya?
translation: هل يعاني أحد في عائلتك من مرض في الغدة الدرقية؟

english: Do you have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka ir-ti-faa fee DAGHT ad-dam aw fil-ko-les-te-ROL?
translation: هل لديك ارتفاع في ضغط الدم أو في الكوليسترول؟

english: Do you have any kidney or heart problems?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka ay mush-ki-LAAT fil-KIL-ya aw al-QALB?
translation: هل لديك أي مشكلات في الكلى أو القلب؟

english: Have you had any surgery?
transliteration: hal kha-DA-ta li-ayya A-ma-li-ya ji-RAA-hi-ya?
translation: هل خضعت لأي عملية جراحية؟

english: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
transliteration: hal an-ti HAA-mil aw tu-khat-tee-TEEN lil-HAML?
translation: هل أنت حامل أو تخططين للحمل؟

english: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
transliteration: hal tu-DKHI-nu aw tash-rab al-ku-HOOL?
translation: هل تدخن أو تشرب الكحول؟

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka ha-saa-si-ya min ay da-WAA?
translation: هل لديك حساسية من أي دواء؟

english: I am going to measure your height and weight.
transliteration: sa-AQ-ees TOO-lak wa-WAZ-nak.
translation: سأقيس طولك ووزنك.

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: sa-AQ-ees DAGHT da-mik.
translation: سأقيس ضغط دمك.

english: Please hold your hands out in front of you.
transliteration: min FAD-lik, mud YAD-dayk a-MAA-mak.
translation: من فضلك، مدّ يديك أمامك.

english: I am checking whether your hands are shaking.
transliteration: a-ta-haq-qaqu mim-maa i-dhaa kaa-nat ya-DAAK tar-ta-i-SHAAN.
translation: أتحقق مما إذا كانت يداك ترتعشان.

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: min FAD-lik, a-mil raA-sak i-la al-KHALF qa-LEE-lan.
translation: من فضلك، أمل رأسك إلى الخلف قليلًا.

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: min FAD-lik, ib-laA bay-na-maa af-HAS ra-QA-ba-tak.
translation: من فضلك، ابتلع بينما أفحص رقبتك.

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: sa-a-ta-has-sas al-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya la-dayk.
translation: سأتحسس الغدة الدرقية لديك.

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: min FAD-lik, TAA-bi iS-ba-ee-ka bi-aY-na-yik.
translation: من فضلك، تابع إصبعي بعينيك.

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: sa-AF-has QAA-da-mayk bah-than AA-nit-ta-qa-RU-haat.
translation: سأفحص قدميك بحثًا عن التقرحات.

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: min FAD-lik, akh-bir-nee in-da-maa tash-U-ru bi-HAA-thi al-LAM-sa.
translation: من فضلك، أخبرني عندما تشعر بهذه اللمسة.

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: sa-AF-has ru-DOOD af-AA-lik.
translation: سأفحص ردود أفعالك.

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: naH-taa-ju i-la ij-RAA-i FAS dam lit-ta-haq-quq min hur-MO-naat al-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya la-dayk.
translation: نحتاج إلى إجراء فحص دم للتحقق من هرمونات الغدة الدرقية لديك.

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: sa-naF-has HbA1c li-taQ-yeem mu-ta-WAS-siT mus-ta-WAA as-SUK-kar fee DA-mik.
translation: سنفحص HbA1c لتقييم متوسط مستوى السكر في دمك.

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: naH-taa-ju i-la FAS wa-ZAA-if al-KIL-ya la-dayk.
translation: نحتاج إلى فحص وظائف الكلى لديك.

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: sa-naF-has mus-ta-WAA al-ko-les-te-ROL la-dayk.
translation: سنفحص مستوى الكوليسترول لديك.

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: naH-taa-ju i-la AA-ye-na BAWL.
translation: نحتاج إلى عينة بول.

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: qad taH-taa-ju i-la tas-weer al-GHAD-da ad-da-ra-QI-ya bil-maw-JAAT fawq as-SAW-ti-ya.
translation: قد تحتاج إلى تصوير الغدة الدرقية بالموجات فوق الصوتية.

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: qad naH-taa-ju i-la ij-RAA-i FAS li-ka-thaa-fa-t al-i-ZAAM.
translation: قد نحتاج إلى إجراء فحص لكثافة العظام.

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: yur-JAA it-ti-BAA taA-lee-MAAT as-SI-yaam al-khaaS-Sa bi-HAA-thal-FAS.
translation: يُرجى اتباع تعليمات الصيام الخاصة بهذا الفحص.

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: sa-na-RAA-ji ad-WI-ya-tik ma-A-an.
translation: سنراجع أدويتك معًا.

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: yur-JAA ta-na-WAAL ha-dha ad-da-WAA has-ba at-taA-lee-MAAT al-la-tee wu-SI-fat lak.
translation: يُرجى تناول هذا الدواء حسب التعليمات التي وُصفت لك.

english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: la tu-GHAY-yir JUR-at al-an-su-LEEN min DOON taw-JEEH.
translation: لا تغيّر جرعة الإنسولين من دون توجيه.

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.

translation: لا توقف أدوية الستيرويد التي تتناولها لفترة طويلة فجأة من دون استشارة طبية.

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: yum-ki-nu-na tar-TEEB maw-id lak ma-a mu-thaq-QAF fee ma-RAD as-SUK-ka-ree.
translation: يمكننا ترتيب موعد لك مع مثقّف في مرض السكري.

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: yur-JAA ih-DAAR ad-WI-ya-tik wa-qi-RAA-aat mus-ta-WAA as-SUK-kar fid-dam fil-MAR-ra al-QAA-di-ma.
translation: يُرجى إحضار أدويتك وقراءات مستوى السكر في الدم في المرة القادمة.

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: sa-nu-NAA-qish khit-TAN tu-naa-si-buk.
translation: سنناقش خطة تناسبك.

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-nu-AAS sha-deed aw bi-ta-shaw-WUSH?
translation: هل تشعر بنعاس شديد أو بتشوش؟

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-QAY-ya-u wa-la ta-sta-TEE-u al-iH-ti-FAA-Z bil-saw-aa-il fee miA-da-tik?
translation: هل تتقيأ ولا تستطيع الاحتفاظ بالسوائل في معدتك؟

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-daAF sha-deed aw hal ugh-mee AA-layk?
translation: هل تشعر بضعف شديد أو هل أُغمي عليك؟

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: ma maw-id al-mu-TAA-ba-a al-QAA-dim?
translation: متى موعد المتابعة القادم؟

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka ay as-i-la AA-nil-khit-ta?
translation: هل لديك أي أسئلة عن الخطة؟

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: ma al-la-dhee ta-wad an u-saa-i-da-ka fee-ha al-YAWM?

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: kay-fa kaan shu-U-ruk fil-faT-ra al-a-KHEE-ra?

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: yum-ki-nu-ka an tu-KH-bir-nee idhaa kaan a-HAD al-as-i-la yu-SA-bib lak AA-dam ir-ti-YAAH.
translation: يمكنك أن تخبرني إذا كان أحد الأسئلة يسبب لك عدم ارتياح.

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: sa-as-ta-mi-u i-layk min DOON an aH-kum AA-layk.

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: hal tu-faD-Dil at-ta-HAD-duth ma-a mu-tar-jim sha-fa-HEE?
translation: هل تفضّل التحدث مع مترجم شفهي؟

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?

english: Are you able to go to work or school?

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: hal kun-ta tash-U-ru bil-huZN aw bil-ih-BAT?

transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bil-yaAS tijaa al-mus-taQ-bal?
translation: هل تشعر باليأس تجاه المستقبل؟

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bidh-dhanb aw bi-an-na-ka bi-la QEE-ma?
translation: هل تشعر بالذنب أو بأنك بلا قيمة؟

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: hal tab-kee ak-thar min al-mu-TAAD?
translation: هل تبكي أكثر من المعتاد؟

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-khafD fee TAA-qa-tik?
translation: هل تشعر بانخفاض في طاقتك؟

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: hal ta-jid su-U-ba fee at-tar-KEEZ aw it-ti-KHAA-d al-qa-RAA-raat?
translation: هل تجد صعوبة في التركيز أو اتخاذ القرارات؟

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-ghay-yu-ran fee sha-HEE-ya-tik?
translation: هل لاحظت تغيرًا في شهيتك؟

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ay ta-ghay-yur fee WAZ-nik?
translation: هل لاحظت أي تغير في وزنك؟

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bil-qa-LAQ aw at-ta-WAT-tur ka-THEE-ran?
translation: هل تشعر بالقلق أو التوتر كثيرًا؟

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: hal yaS-U-bu AA-layk at-ta-haK-kum fee qa-la-Qik?
translation: هل يصعب عليك التحكم في قلقك؟

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bit-ta-mal-mul aw bit-ta-WAT-tur?
translation: هل تشعر بالتململ أو بالتوتر؟

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: hal taA-tee-ka naw-baat mu-faa-ji-a min al-khawf ash-sha-deed?
translation: هل تأتيك نوبات مفاجئة من الخوف الشديد؟

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: ath-NAA-a haa-dhih an-naw-baat, hal ta-ta-saa-ra-u da-ra-BAAT QAL-bik?
translation: أثناء هذه النوبات، هل تتسارع ضربات قلبك؟

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-DHEEQ fin-na-fas in-da-maa ta-koon qa-li-QAN?
translation: هل تشعر بضيق في التنفس عندما تكون قلقًا؟

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-jan-na-bu a-MAA-kin khaw-fan min an tu-SAAB bi-naw-bat ha-la?
translation: هل تتجنب أماكن خوفًا من أن تصاب بنوبة هلع؟

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: hal ta-raa-wi-du-ka af-KAAR ghayr mar-GHOOB fee-ha bis-ti-MRAAR?
translation: هل تراودك أفكار غير مرغوب فيها باستمرار؟

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-an-na AA-layk tik-RAAR af-AAL mu-ay-ya-na?
translation: هل تشعر بأن عليك تكرار أفعال معينة؟

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: kam saaA-ta ta-NAAM kul LAY-la?
translation: كم ساعة تنام كل ليلة؟

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: hal ta-jid su-U-ba fin-NAWM?
translation: هل تجد صعوبة في النوم؟

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: hal tas-tee-QIZ ka-THEE-ran ath-NAA-a al-LAYL?
translation: هل تستيقظ كثيرًا أثناء الليل؟

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: hal tas-tee-QIZ qab-la al-waQT al-la-dhee tu-REE-du?
translation: هل تستيقظ قبل الوقت الذي تريده؟

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bir-RAA-ha in-da-maa tas-tee-QIZ sa-BAA-han?
translation: هل تشعر بالراحة عندما تستيقظ صباحًا؟

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: hal ta-raa-wi-du-ka ka-WAA-bees?
translation: هل تراودك كوابيس؟

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: hal kun-ta ta-NAAM ak-thar bi-ka-THEER min al-mu-TAAD?
translation: هل كنت تنام أكثر بكثير من المعتاد؟

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bit-taA-b ath-NAA-a an-na-HAAR?
translation: هل تشعر بالتعب أثناء النهار؟

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: hal mar-rat AA-layk fa-TRAAT sha-A-rta fee-ha bi-na-SHAAT aw ha-MAAS ghayr mu-TAAD?
translation: هل مرّت عليك فترات شعرت فيها بنشاط أو حماس غير معتاد؟

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: hal ih-taj-ta i-la naw-min aqall bi-ka-THEER min al-mu-TAAD min DOON an tash-U-ra bit-taA-b?
translation: هل احتجت إلى نوم أقل بكثير من المعتاد من دون أن تشعر بالتعب؟

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: hal qaal lak aa-kha-ROON in-na-ka kun-ta ta-ta-HAD-dath bi-sur-a ghayr mu-TA-da?
translation: هل قال لك آخرون إنك كنت تتحدث بسرعة غير معتادة؟

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: hal kaa-nat af-KAAR-uk ta-ta-saa-ra-u?
translation: هل كانت أفكارك تتسارع؟

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: hal sha-A-rta bi-thi-Qa aw qu-wa ghayr mu-TAAD?
translation: هل شعرت بثقة أو قوة غير معتادة؟

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: hal an-faq-ta maa-lan ak-thar mim-maa kun-ta tan-WEE?
translation: هل أنفقت مالًا أكثر مما كنت تنوي؟

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: hal khuD-ta ma-khaa-TIR ghayr mu-TA-da khilAAL haa-dhih al-fa-TRAAT?
translation: هل خضت مخاطر غير معتادة خلال هذه الفترات؟

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: kam is-ta-MAR-rat haa-dhih al-fa-TRAAT?
translation: كم استمرت هذه الفترات؟

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: hal sa-miA-ta as-WAAT laa yas-ma-u-ha al-aa-kha-ROON?
translation: هل سمعت أصواتًا لا يسمعها الآخرون؟

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: hal ra-AAY-ta ash-YAA laa yas-ta-TEE-u al-aa-kha-ROON ru-YA-ta-ha?
translation: هل رأيت أشياء لا يستطيع الآخرون رؤيتها؟

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-an-na a-ha-dan yu-RAA-qi-buk aw yat-ba-u-k?
translation: هل تشعر بأن أحدًا يراقبك أو يتبعك؟

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-an-na a-ha-dan yu-REED ee-DHAA-ak?
translation: هل تشعر بأن أحدًا يريد إيذاءك؟

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-an-na a-ha-dan ya-ta-HAA-kam fee af-KAAR-ik?
translation: هل تشعر بأن أحدًا يتحكم في أفكارك؟

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: hal taA-mu-ruk al-as-WAAT aH-yaa-nan bi-fiA-li shay?
translation: هل تأمرك الأصوات أحيانًا بفعل شيء؟

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: ma maA-naa haa-dhih at-ta-JAA-rib bin- nis-ba-ti i-layk?
translation: ما معنى هذه التجارب بالنسبة إليك؟

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: hal tu-khee-fuk haa-dhih at-ta-JAA-rib?
translation: هل تخيفك هذه التجارب؟

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: aa-ya-na, in-da-maa yash-U-ru an-naas bi-an-na al-u-MOOR taf-OOQ qud-ra-ta-hum AA-la at-ta-HAM-mul, yu-fak-ki-ROON fil-MAWT. hal ha-da-tha dha-lik ma-A-ak?
translation: أحيانًا، عندما يشعر الناس بأن الأمور تفوق قدرتهم على التحمل، يفكرون في الموت. هل حدث ذلك معك؟

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: hal ta-man-nay-ta an ta-NAAM wa-la tas-tee-QIZ?
translation: هل تمنيت أن تنام ولا تستيقظ؟

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: hal raa-wa-da-tak af-KAAR bi-in-HAA-a ha-yaA-tik?
translation: هل راودتك أفكار بإنهاء حياتك؟

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: hal ta-raa-wi-du-ka haa-dhih al-af-KAAR al-AAN?
translation: هل تراودك هذه الأفكار الآن؟

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: hal fak-kar-ta fit-ta-REE-qa al-la-tee qad tun-hee bi-haa ha-yaA-tak?
translation: هل فكرت في الطريقة التي قد تنهي بها حياتك؟

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: hal wa-DAA-ta khit-ta li-in-HAA-i ha-yaA-tik?
translation: هل وضعت خطة لإنهاء حياتك؟

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: hal yum-ki-nuk al-wu-SOOL i-la ay shay qad tas-ta-KH-di-mu-hu li-ee-DHAA naF-sik?
translation: هل يمكنك الوصول إلى أي شيء قد تستخدمه لإيذاء نفسك؟

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: hal haa-wal-ta min QABL in-HAA-a ha-yaA-tik?
translation: هل حاولت من قبل إنهاء حياتك؟

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: hal aa-day-ta naF-sak min QABL AA-mdan?
translation: هل آذيت نفسك من قبل عمدًا؟

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: ma al-la-dhee saa-a-da-ka AA-la al-hi-FAAZ AA-la sa-laa-ma-tik haT-ta al-AAN?
translation: ما الذي ساعدك على الحفاظ على سلامتك حتى الآن؟

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: hal hun-aa-ka shakhs ta-theq bi-hi yum-ki-nu-na al-it-ti-SAAL bi-hi?
translation: هل هناك شخص تثق به يمكننا الاتصال به؟

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: a-na QAA-liq bi-SA-laa-ma-tik wa-u-REED mu-saa-a-da-tak AA-la al-ba-QAA bi-a-MAAN.
translation: أنا قلق بشأن سلامتك وأريد مساعدتك على البقاء بأمان.

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bil-a-MAAN fil-ma-KAAN al-la-dhee ta-AEESH fee-hi?
translation: هل تشعر بالأمان في المكان الذي تعيش فيه؟

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: hal had-da-dak a-ha-dun aw aa-dhaak?
translation: هل هددك أحد أو آذاك؟

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: hal ta-khaa-fu min a-ha-d fee al-MAN-zil?
translation: هل تخاف من أحد في المنزل؟

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: hal raa-wa-da-tak af-KAAR bi-ee-DHAA shakhs aa-khar?
translation: هل راودتك أفكار بإيذاء شخص آخر؟

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: hal tu-fak-ki-ru fee ee-DHAA shakhs mu-ay-yan?
translation: هل تفكر في إيذاء شخص معين؟

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: hal la-day-ka khit-ta li-ee-DHAA ay shakhs?
translation: هل لديك خطة لإيذاء أي شخص؟

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: hal yoo-jad aT-FAAL aw ash-KHAA-S aa-kha-ROON yaH-taa-juun i-la ri-AA-ya khaaS-Sa fil-man-zil?
translation: هل يوجد أطفال أو أشخاص آخرون يحتاجون إلى رعاية خاصة في المنزل؟

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: hal ma-rar-ta bi-taj-ri-ba mu-khee-fa aw Saa-di-ma?
translation: هل مررت بتجربة مخيفة أو صادمة؟

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: la ya-lza-mu-ka an tu-shaa-rik at-ta-faa-SEEL qab-la an ta-koon mus-ta-iD-dan.
translation: لا يلزمك أن تشارك التفاصيل قبل أن تكون مستعدًا.

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: hal ta-OO-du i-layk dhik-raa-yaat til-ka at-taj-ri-ba bi-shakl ghayr mu-ta-waQ-qa?
translation: هل تعود إليك ذكريات تلك التجربة بشكل غير متوقع؟

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: hal ta-raa-wi-du-ka ka-WAA-bees AA-maa ha-dath?
translation: هل تراودك كوابيس عما حدث؟

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-jan-nab maa yu-dhak-ki-ruk bi-maa ha-dath?
translation: هل تتجنب ما يذكرك بما حدث؟

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru bi-an-na-ka daa-i-man mu-TA-yiq aw ghayr aa-min?
translation: هل تشعر بأنك دائمًا متيقظ أو غير آمن؟

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: hal tash-U-ru aH-yaa-nan bi-an-na-ka mun-fa-Sil AA-n naF-sik aw am-maa haw-lak?
translation: هل تشعر أحيانًا بأنك منفصل عن نفسك أو عما حولك؟

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: hal tash-ra-bul-ku-HOOL
translation: هِلْ تَشْرُبُ الْكُحُول ؟

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: KAM MAR-ra TASH-rab, wa KAM TASH-rab fee KUL mar-ra?
translation: كم مرة تشرب، وكم تشرب في كل مرة؟

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: hal RAGHIB-ta fee at-taq-LEEL min SHURB al-ku-HOOL?
translation: هل رغبت في التقليل من شرب الكحول؟

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: hal AB-da A-ha-dun qa-LA-qah bi-SHUR-bik lil-ku-HOOL?
translation: هل أبدى أحد قلقه بشأن شربك للكحول؟

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: hal TAS-ta-khdim al-QAN-nab?
translation: هل تستخدم القنب؟

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: hal TAS-ta-khdim al-KOO-kay-een aw al-maw-WAAD al-oo-fee-OO-nee-yah aw moo-KHAD-di-rat oo-khra?
translation: هل تستخدم الكوكايين أو المواد الأفيونية أو مخدرات أخرى؟

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: hal SA-ba-qa an qa-NAN-ta NAF-sa-ka bil-moo-KHAD-di-rat?
translation: هل سبق أن حقنت نفسك بالمخدرات؟

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: MA-ta KA-nat AA-khir MAR-ra is-ta-KHAD-dam-ta fee-ha al-ku-HOOL aw MAW-waad oo-khra?
translation: متى كانت آخر مرة استخدمت فيها الكحول أو مواد أخرى؟

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: hal TASH-o-r bil-ir-ti-SHAA-ash aw bit-ta-WA-ok-o IN-da ta-TA-waq-qaf an is-ti-KHDA-mi-ha?
translation: هل تشعر بالارتعاش أو بالتوعك عندما تتوقف عن استخدامها؟

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: hal SA-ba-qa an OO-sib-ta bi-NAW-bat ta-SHAN-nooj ath-NAA al-in-si-HAAB?
translation: هل سبق أن أُصبت بنوبة تشنج أثناء الانسحاب؟

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: hal TAR-ghab fee al-ho-SOOL a-la DAAM li-taq-LEEL is-ti-KHDAAM al-maw-WAAD aw at-ta-WAQ-qof an-ha?
translation: هل ترغب في الحصول على دعم لتقليل استخدام المواد أو التوقف عنها؟

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: ma RA-yok fee AA-daa-tik al-ghi-thaa-ee-yah?
translation: ما رأيك في عاداتك الغذائية؟

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: hal taQ-laq KA-thee-ran bi-SHAK-li waz-nik aw JIS-mik?
translation: هل تقلق كثيرًا بشأن وزنك أو شكل جسمك؟

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: hal i-TA-dat ta-KHAT-tee al-WA-ja-baat aw taQ-yeed ma TAA-ko-loh?
translation: هل اعتدت تخطي الوجبات أو تقييد ما تأكله؟

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: hal TASH-o-ro AH-ya-nan an-nak la ta-STA-tee-o at-ta-WAQ-qof an al-AKL?
translation: هل تشعر أحيانًا أنك لا تستطيع التوقف عن الأكل؟

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: hal ja-AL-ta NAF-sa-ka ta-TA-ya-ya-o ba-dal-AKL?
translation: هل جعلت نفسك تتقيأ بعد الأكل؟

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: hal MAA-rast ar-ri-YAA-da li-ta-WEED ma A-kal-tah?
translation: هل مارست الرياضة لتعويض ما أكلته؟

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: hal WAA-jahta SOO-o-ba fee at-tar-KEEZ?
translation: هل واجهت صعوبة في التركيز؟

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: hal tan-SA al-ma-WAA-eed aw al-ma-HAAM-ma KA-thee-ran?
translation: هل تنسى المواعيد أو المهام كثيرًا؟

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ta-ghay-yoo-RAAT fee THAA-ki-ra-tik?
translation: هل لاحظت تغيرات في ذاكرتك؟

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: hal ta-JID SOO-o-ba fee tan-ZEEM al-ma-HAAM?
translation: هل تجد صعوبة في تنظيم المهام؟

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: hal TASH-o-r bil-ir-ti-BAAK?
translation: هل تشعر بالارتباك؟

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz A-ha-dun ta-ghay-yoo-ran fee soo-LOO-kik?
translation: هل لاحظ أحد تغيرًا في سلوكك؟

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: hal yum-KEE-no-ka an TUKH-bi-ra-nee bi-IS-mik al-KAA-mil?
translation: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني باسمك الكامل؟

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: hal yum-KEE-no-ka an TUKH-bi-ra-nee bi-taa-REEKH al-YAWM?
translation: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني بتاريخ اليوم؟

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: hal yum-KEE-no-ka an TUKH-bi-ra-nee AY-na nah-no al-AAN?
translation: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني أين نحن الآن؟

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: sa-a-QOO-lo tha-LAA-tha ka-li-MAAT, min FAD-lik kar-RIR-ha.
translation: سأقول ثلاث كلمات، من فضلك كررها.

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: haa-wil min FAD-lik an ta-ta-THAK-kar til-ka al-ka-li-MAAT li-WAQT laa-HIQ.
translation: حاول من فضلك أن تتذكر تلك الكلمات لوقت لاحق.

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: hal yum-KEE-no-ka an TUKH-bi-ra-nee bi-til-ka al-ka-li-MAAT ath-tha-LAA-th al-AAN?
translation: هل يمكنك أن تخبرني بتلك الكلمات الثلاث الآن؟

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: hal yum-KEE-no-ka tah-JEE-a ka-LI-mah bil-AKS?
translation: هل يمكنك تهجئة كلمة بالعكس؟

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: ma all-a-thee ta-ta-QID an-na-ho ya-SA-bib haa-thee-hi as-soo-OO-baat?
translation: ما الذي تعتقد أنه يسبب هذه الصعوبات؟

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: KAY-fa ta-SIF HAA-la-ta-ka al-mi-ZAA-jee-yah al-YAWM?
translation: كيف تصف حالتك المزاجية اليوم؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: hal SA-ba-qa an RAA-ja-ta ta-BEE-ban naf-see-yan aw mus-ta-SHA-ran?
translation: هل سبق أن راجعت طبيبًا نفسيًا أو مستشارًا؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: hal SA-ba-qa an OOD-khil-ta i-la al-mus-tash-fa li-tal-QEE ri-AA-yah lis-siH-Ha an-naf-see-yah?
translation: هل سبق أن أُدخلت إلى المستشفى لتلقي رعاية للصحة النفسية؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: hal AA-na A-ha-dun fee AA-i-la-tik min SOO-o-baat fee as-siH-Ha an-naf-see-yah?
translation: هل عانى أحد في عائلتك من صعوبات في الصحة النفسية؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: hal la-DAY-ka ay-ya HAA-laat siH-HEE-yah?
translation: هل لديك أي حالات صحية؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: ma-an man ta-EE-sh?
translation: مع من تعيش؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: i-LAA man yum-KEE-no-ka al-lu-JOO-o li-ho-SOOL a-la ad-DAAM?
translation: إلى من يمكنك اللجوء للحصول على الدعم؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: hal WAA-jahta moo-a-kha-ran SOO-o-baat MAA-lee-yah aw sa-ka-NEE-yah?
translation: هل واجهت مؤخرًا صعوبات مالية أو سكنية؟

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: hal ta-SA-bib la-ka i-la-QAA-tok taw-TA-ran?
translation: هل تسبب لك علاقاتك توترًا؟

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: ma al-ad-WEE-yah al-la-tee ta-ta-NAA-wa-lo-ha al-AAN?
translation: ما الأدوية التي تتناولها الآن؟

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NAA-wal ad-WEE-yah moo-DAAD-da lil-ik-ti-AAAB?
translation: هل تتناول أدوية مضادة للاكتئاب؟

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NAA-wal da-WAA-an lil-QALQ?
translation: هل تتناول دواءً للقلق؟

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NAA-wal ad-WEE-yah moo-DAAD-da lith-tha-HAA-nee?
translation: هل تتناول أدوية مضادة للذهان؟

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NAA-wal da-WAA-an li-tath-BEET al-mi-ZAAJ?
translation: هل تتناول دواءً لتثبيت المزاج؟

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-NAA-wal hoo-BOO-ban moo-NEE-mah aw ad-WEE-yah min fi-at al-ban-zo-dee-yaa-zee-PEEN-aat?
translation: هل تتناول حبوبًا منومة أو أدوية من فئة البنزوديازيبينات؟

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: ma al-JOR-ah al-la-tee ta-ta-NAA-wa-lo-ha, wa KAM MAR-ra?
translation: ما الجرعة التي تتناولها، وكم مرة؟

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: mun-thoo MA-ta wa anta ta-ta-NAA-wal haa-tha ad-da-WAA?
translation: منذ متى وأنت تتناول هذا الدواء؟

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: hal FAA-ta-tak ay-yo JOR-aat moo-a-kha-ran?
translation: هل فاتتك أي جرعات مؤخرًا؟

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: hal sa-AA-da-ka ad-da-WAA?
translation: هل ساعدك الدواء؟

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: hal LAA-haz-ta ay-ya AA-thaar JAA-ni-bee-yah?
translation: هل لاحظت أي آثار جانبية؟

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: hal ta-WAQ-qaf-ta an ta-NAA-wal ay-ya da-WAA moo-a-kha-ran?
translation: هل توقفت عن تناول أي دواء مؤخرًا؟

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: ma AH-daa-fok min al-i-LAAJ?
translation: ما أهدافك من العلاج؟

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: hal TAR-ghab fee al-i-LAAJ bil-ka-LAAM aw al-is-ti-SHAA-rah an-naf-see-yah?
translation: هل ترغب في العلاج بالكلام أو الاستشارة النفسية؟

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: yum-KEE-no-na moo-NAA-qa-shat khi-YAA-raat al-ad-WEE-yah ma-an.
translation: يمكننا مناقشة خيارات الأدوية معًا.

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: ta-HAAJ ba-dal-ad-WEE-yah i-la-id-AA-a asaa-BEE ma-TA ta-ZHAR ma-FAA-o-lo-ha bil-KAA-mil.
translation: تحتاج بعض الأدوية إلى عدة أسابيع حتى يظهر مفعولها بالكامل.

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: yur-JAA at-ta-HAD-doth ma-a ta-BEE-bik QAB-la at-ta-WAQ-qof an ta-NAA-wal ad-da-WAA.
translation: يرجى التحدث مع طبيبك قبل التوقف عن تناول الدواء.

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: hal TAR-ghab fee an NOOSH-rik A-ha-da af-RAAD AA-i-la-tik tha-THIQ bih?
translation: هل ترغب في أن نشرك أحد أفراد عائلتك تثق به؟

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: yum-KEE-no-na WAD-o KHUT-ta li-ma yan-ba-GHEE fi-LO-ho i-tha iz-daa-dat al-A-RAAD soo-AA.
translation: يمكننا وضع خطة لما ينبغي فعله إذا ازدادت الأعراض سوءًا.

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: ma ma-KHAA-wi-fok bi-SHAAN al-i-LAAJ?
translation: ما مخاوفك بشأن العلاج؟

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: hal TASH-o-r bil-a-MAAN IN-da ar-ROO-o ilal-BAYT al-YAWM?
translation: هل تشعر بالأمان عند العودة إلى المنزل اليوم؟

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: man yum-KEE-no-ka al-it-ti-SAAL bih i-tha SHA-art an-na-ka ghay-ro AA-min?
translation: من يمكنك الاتصال به إذا شعرت أنك غير آمن؟

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: hal yum-KEE-no-na tah-DEED a-LAA-maat tah-THEER tad-DOOL a-la an al-oo-MOOR ta-ZDAAD soo-AA?
translation: هل يمكننا تحديد علامات تحذيرية تدل على أن الأمور تزداد سوءًا؟

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: i-tha KUN-ta fee KHA-tar faW-ree, faT-loob al-mu-SAA-a-da at-taa-ri-ah.
translation: إذا كنت في خطر فوري، فاطلب المساعدة الطارئة.

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: yum-KEE-no-na tar-TEEB maw-id lil-moo-taa-ba-ah.
translation: يمكننا ترتيب موعد للمتابعة.

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: hal TAR-ghab fee ma-loo-MAAT an kha-da-MAAT ad-DAAM al-ma-HAL-lee-yah?
translation: هل ترغب في معلومات عن خدمات الدعم المحلية؟

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: hal hoo-NA-ka ay-yo SHAY-in AA-khar ta-WAD an TAS-al an-ho?
translation: هل هناك أي شيء آخر تود أن تسأل عنه؟

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: sa-aT-RAH a-LAY-ka ba-dal-as-i-LA an a-RAA-dik.
translation: سأطرح عليك بعض الأسئلة عن أعراضك.

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: ma-TA ba-DA-at a-RAA-dok li-aw-wal MAR-ra?
translation: متى بدأت أعراضك لأول مرة؟

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hal ba-DA-at al-a-RAAD faj-a-tan am tad-ree-JEE-yan?
translation: هل بدأت الأعراض فجأة أم تدريجيًا؟

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: MA-tha kun-ta taf-a-lo IN-da-ma ba-da-a haa-tha?
translation: ماذا كنت تفعل عندما بدأ هذا؟

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: hal al-a-RAAD mus-ta-MIR-ra am ta-TEE wa-ta-THEH?
translation: هل الأعراض مستمرة أم تأتي وتذهب؟

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: KAM tas-ta-MIR KUL NAW-ba?
translation: كم تستمر كل نوبة؟

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: KAM MAR-ra yah-dooth haa-tha fil-YAWM aw al-oo-SBOO?
translation: كم مرة يحدث هذا في اليوم أو الأسبوع؟

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: hal ta-ta-HAS-san a-RAA-dok am ta-SOO am taB-qa ka-MAA hee?
translation: هل تتحسن أعراضك أم تسوء أم تبقى كما هي؟

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: hal SA-ba-qa an WAA-jahta haa-thi-hi al-mush-KI-la?
translation: هل سبق أن واجهت هذه المشكلة؟

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: hal hoo-NA-ka SHAY-un yaj-a-lo-ha AH-san aw as-WA?
translation: هل هناك شيء يجعلها أفضل أو أسوأ؟

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: akh-BIR-nee FAW-ran min FAD-lik i-tha SHA-art bit-ta-WA-ok ATH-na al-faHS.
translation: أخبرني فورًا من فضلك إذا شعرت بالتوعك أثناء الفحص.

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: hal O-sib-ta faj-a-tan bi-DAF fee AH-d jan-i-bay JIS-mik?
translation: هل أصبت فجأة بضعف في أحد جانبي جسمك؟

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: hal ta-DAL-la AH-d jan-i-bay WAH-jik faj-a-tan?
translation: هل تدلى أحد جانبي وجهك فجأة؟

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: hal WAA-jahta faj-a-tan SOO-o-ba fee al-ka-LAAM?
translation: هل واجهت فجأة صعوبة في الكلام؟

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: hal WAA-jahta faj-a-tan SOO-o-ba fee FAHM al-ka-LAAM?
translation: هل واجهت فجأة صعوبة في فهم الكلام؟
